verdict.rationale: Metorial's docs say it ships official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs. They include a code sample of `metorial.connect`, typed SDK errors, a recommended `@metorial/ai-sdk` package, and adapters for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. A live probe confirmed the developer quickstart is reachable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually installing and building with the SDKs, and documented depth for the Python and Go SDKs beyond the headline claim.
